BuildWeek Online Hackathon

Overview
Build anything that helps students learn. Teams can have up to 3 members.

How Projects Will Be Judged
- Usefulness
- Creativity
- Technical execution
- Polish

Deliverables
Every team must submit a 2-minute video demo and a link to the code repository.
A live deployed demo link is required for the People's Choice award.

Deadline
Submissions close on 2026-04-02 at 23:59 UTC.
Projects that use paid APIs without disclosing them will be ineligible.
